subject: Error in loading ’gWidgetstcltk’ post shiny dashboard update

messages.author: 6c4d187713e325b8
messages.subject: Error in loading ’gWidgetstcltk’ post shiny dashboard update
parts:
Hi,
    My Shiny apps were working fine until I updated Shiny and Shiny Dashboard and now receive the following error on my apps when trying to upload to shiny.io. Rendering in rStudio works fine. Just wondering if anyone else had this happen and if they had any suggestions regarding a fix?

Cheers,
     Conal

messages.author: d6ebe55625e8e5a2
messages.subject: Re: Error in loading ’gWidgetstcltk’ post shiny dashboard update
parts: It seems like shinyapps.io can't find the package "codetools". If this is a package from CRAN or Github, just make sure to to library(codetools) explicitly in your app code and you should be fine.

messages.author: 6c4d187713e325b8
messages.subject: Re: Error in loading ’gWidgetstcltk’ post shiny dashboard update
parts:
Amazing, thank you so much we can help! Great Idea and I ran the same solution for the second error.
The fix was the following:


library("codetools")         #      Fixed the error for "Warning: no DISPLAY variable so Tk is not available
code for methods in class “TcltkWidget” was not checked for suspicious field assignments (recommended package ‘codetools’ not available?)"
library(("gWidgets")        #     Fixed the error for Error : unable to load R code in package ‘gWidgetstcltk’

ERROR: lazy loading failed for package ‘gWidgetstcltk’
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/gWidgetstcltk’

On Thursday, August 3, 2017 at 1:15:38 AM UTC+10, Bárbara Borges wrote:
